title: Fattah AgentGuard — Coding Agent Activity Log Event
description: Structure for a single coding-agent activity event. Datasets are NDJSON: one JSON object matching this schema per line. The detection engine reads only the operational fields below; the ground-truth block (label, owasp) is for scoring accuracy and MUST be ignored by detections.

timestamp.description: UTC ISO-8601 time the event occurred.

session_id.description: Groups events from one agent session. Correlation rules key on this.

agent.description: Which coding agent produced the event.

user.description: Developer the agent is acting on behalf of.

repo.description: Repository the agent is working in.

event_type.description: The kind of activity. payload fields depend on this.

payload.description: Event-specific fields. Shape depends on event_type.

text.description: prompt: user/agent input or content the agent read.

source.description: prompt/file_read: where the content came from (readme, issue, comment, .cursorrules, user).

detail.description: git_operation: args, remote URL, branch, or commit diff.

body_size.description: api_call: request body size in bytes.

body_snippet.description: api_call: short excerpt of the request body.

label.description: GROUND TRUTH for scoring only. Detections MUST NOT read this.

owasp.description: GROUND TRUTH OWASP LLM category for scoring only (empty for benign). Detections MUST NOT read this.
